MU and ORCL lead in premium and return metrics but require new capital and are not owned. Stocks like PANW and SPY offer very low returns and thus are less attractive. The investor currently owns HIMS and NFLX which are not in this top scan, suggesting a tradeoff between immediate high yield versus simplicity and capital usage. Prefer owned stocks unless the new stock is considerably better on all counts.
